'''Foehorn''' was a huge and furious [[Tulrus/Legends|tulrus]] that lived on the volcanic world [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These creatures usually didn't bother anyone unless provoked, but Foehorn was exceptionally aggressive.

Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the beast attacked several mining crews, leaving several wounded and killed [[Miner/Legends|miners]] behind. The mining crews refused to go out unless the [[Mensix Mining Company]] could take care of the problem, so Chief [[Ulon Glost]] hired an expert [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] to track down the beast and kill it. The hunter was still searching for the tulrus, when Chief Glost received news of yet another attack on a [[Dying miner's camp|mining camp]]. When the hunter arrived at the camp, most of the miners were already dead or dying. After a fierce fight, the hunter killed Foehorn and returned to the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]].

==Behind the scenes==
Foehorn was a creature in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']], the third expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. The quest [[:w:c:swg:The Man-eater|The Man-eater]] sent the player to kill several tulruses, then Ulon Glost sent a new waypoint to a mining camp. When the player arrived there, Foehorn attacked and had to be killed to complete the quest.
